narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Paperback Series Shelf"**

Forage looks like a run of mid-century paperbacks: one humanist sans, flat ink, and a coloured band that tells you what kind of book it is. Here the band tells you the book's status. Wishlist is orange, owned cerise, reading green, paused ochre, read blue, and dropped grey. Status is the only thing colour encodes. Everything else is ink on a near-white ground, with a single fixed neutral ramp.

The interface is dense and plain because the job is speed. Nine or ten hairline rows fit on a phone screen. The search field is a square ink-outlined box at the top of every shelf. Lists stay quiet: colour shows only as a 5px edge, a swatch or a small tag. Colour fills a large area only when a book is opened. The detail view is drawn as a cover with three bands: a status band, a white title band and a status band. A status change sweeps the old colour off the cover to reveal the new one. That sweep is the system's one bit of theatre.

The world rejects two defaults by name: the grey iOS list with one blue accent, and the cream-and-serif "bookish" app. There are no shadows, gradients, glass or rounded corners anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Status-coded flat band colours, each paired with a fixed on-band text colour.
One fixed neutral ramp (ground, paper, ink, n1 to n5) for light and dark.
One humanist sans (Gill Sans, then Seravek) at every size.
Zero radius. Hairlines (1px) separate. Ink outlines (1.5px) mark anything you can act on.
A three-band cover for the open book, with a status sweep on change.
A square icon grammar: 1.75 stroke, square caps, mitred joins.

rules.name: The Band Means Status Rule
rules.body: A band colour always names a status. Don't use one as a decorative accent. The only exceptions are the sync dot and text selection, which borrow existing inks as signals. Don't add a new hue to the palette.

rules.name: The Full Band Rule
rules.body: Colour fills a large area only on the open book's cover. In lists it shrinks to a 5px edge, a 24x8 swatch, a tag, or the 4px band over a tab.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every grey comes from ground, paper, ink and n1 to n5. Nothing else is grey.

rules.name: The On-Band Pairing Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on a band, whether text, an outline, a star or a date field border, uses that band's on-band colour. Don't put ink on a band unless ink is its on-band.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Gill Sans at every level. Build hierarchy from weight, size and tracking. Never add a second family.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Tracked capitals are only for short labels that name something: the wordmark, a status, a section, a field, a tag, an alphabet letter. Never set titles, sentences or buttons in tracked capitals.

rules.name: The Optical Dot Rule
rules.body: Inline facts are joined with a middle dot inside a span with margins of 0.48em left and 0.22em right. Gill Sans draws the dot right of centre, so a plain " · " looks lopsided. Never type a literal spaced dot.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, gradient, backdrop-filter or translucency anywhere, except the drawer scrim. If something needs separating, use a hairline or a change of fill.

rules.name: The Hairlines, Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Rows, sections and headers are divided by 1px n4 rules. Don't wrap a list item in a card.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Radius is zero everywhere, the dot included. Nothing in the UI is a circle or a pill. The only round shape is the magnifier's lens inside the search icon.

dos: Do set every surface from the token ramp: ground for pages, paper for anything you write in, ink for anything you press.
Do carry status as a 5px edge, a 24x8 swatch, a tag or a 4px tab band in lists, and save full-width colour for the cover.
Do pair every band with its on-band colour for text, outlines, stars and fields drawn on it.
Do separate rows and sections with 1px n4 hairlines, and outline interactive elements in 1.5px ink.
Do draw new icons on the 24px grid with a 1.75 stroke, square caps and mitred joins, coloured with currentColor.
Do join inline facts with the optically spaced middle-dot span (margins 0.48em / 0.22em).
Do use tabular figures for counts, dates, years and ISBNs.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and inputs at 17px.
donts: Don't round any corner, including dots, tags and buttons (0px everywhere).
Don't add box-shadows, gradients, blur or glass. Only the drawer scrim is translucent.
Don't introduce a new hue, or use a band colour to decorate something that isn't a status.
Don't drift toward the grey iOS list with one blue accent, or the cream-and-serif "bookish" app.
Don't add a second typeface, or set titles and sentences in tracked capitals.
Don't wrap rows or sections in cards.
Don't use round line caps or joins in icons, or use emoji or Unicode symbols as icons.
Don't fill a large area with a status colour anywhere except the open book's cover.
